task: D4 AGGREGATION DIAGNOSTIC (frozen model, no retraining)
honesty_constraint: The pre-aggregation scalar is a DIAGNOSTIC PROXY (mean over channels of the frozen signed-difference volume, i.e. the D3 A_L1 reduction) and the post-aggregation scalar is the model's ACTUAL cost (the trained 3D aggregation output that the readout consumes). They are NOT the same kind of object. Only RANKS and ORDERINGS are compared, never raw magnitudes. A POST-OVER-PRE improvement establishes that aggregation RESOLVES ambiguity as measured; near-zero deltas mean it PRESERVES it. No long-range-aggregation claim from the literature is used as evidence, no conclusive-claim language is used, and no mechanism verdict is declared here (step 8 does verdicts).

conventions.geometry: P2A shift=right, 24 candidates, stride 8; identical D3 conventions: nearest-centre GT sampling, gt_cand=GT_px/8, gt_idx=clip(round(gt_cand),0,23), left-edge x<k exclusion from EVERY statistic, cells with x<gt_idx dropped, ok-mask (valid non-neighbourhood AND valid negative) identical for PRE/POST
conventions.pre_object: DIAGNOSTIC PROXY: mean_c |cost_volume| (D3 A_L1 reduction), recomputed from the frozen volume; rank-1 cross-checked against D3 A_L1 per seed
conventions.post_object: model's ACTUAL cost: stages['aggregated_cost']; readout applies softmax(-cost)
conventions.comparison_rule: RANKS and ORDERINGS only, never raw magnitudes
conventions.margin: best valid non-neighbourhood cost minus GT cost; positive = GT candidate preferred
conventions.overlap: fraction of pooled valid negatives scoring better (lower) than the median positive
conventions.entropy: softmax(-cost) over VALID candidates only; PRE value is a PROXY entropy, POST is the model's own
conventions.texture: full-res left grayscale gradient magnitude, mean over each stride-8 cell; per-seed median split
conventions.edge: gt_idx differs by >=2 from any in-bounds 4-neighbour with sampled GT>0
conventions.occlusion: full-res occluded-only mask (valid disp_occ_0 AND invalid disp_noc_0, the reference_strata.py definition) lifted to feature resolution by footprint-max: a surviving cell is occluded if ANY pixel in its stride-8 footprint is occluded-only. Centre-sampling the sparse binary mask yields zero occluded cells, so max-pooling the dense mask is used and stated; HIGH_OCC / HIGH_NONOCC groups test the occlusion confound on the D3 negative high-disparity margin directly
conventions.spatial: POST dense argmax (valid-masked argmin) vs its existing in-bounds 4-neighbours
conventions.low_n: any regime with fewer than 1000 cells is flagged low-n

prior_work.prevs_post_aggregation.py: phase1/runs/arm_v_diag/prevs_post_aggregation.py compares a raw L2-norm cost against the aggregated cost, but on the ARM-V checkpoints (not P2A), at upsampled full resolution with nearest interpolation, standardised softmax, no left-edge exclusion and no D1-bin / occlusion / texture regimes. It frames the same question but answers no part of this brief's measurements; none of its numbers are reused. D3's conventions are used instead so PRE here is exactly comparable to the D3 A_L1 representation.

d3_crosscheck: PRE rank-1 reproduces D3 A_L1 rank-1 per seed to <1e-9 (gate passed before this JSON was written)

interpretation: Factual statement only, no verdict and no conclusive-claim language; step 8 does mechanism verdicts. POST rank-1 materially above PRE with more positive margins and lower overlap = aggregation RESOLVING ambiguity as measured; deltas near zero = aggregation PRESERVING it. No literature claim about long-range aggregation is admitted as evidence; only these deltas count.
unmeasurable: NOT MEASURABLE WITH CURRENT ARTIFACTS: nothing in this brief was unmeasurable; every listed quantity was measured.
